summary.value: Sheraton New York Times Square Hotel is a 51-story hotel located near Times Square on Seventh Avenue, a big full-service base for groups and conventions. Trip.com guests rate it 7.8 / 10 Good 158 reviews and report “Room is great and clean”. Honest watch-out: one guest notes “I expected a sauna/Spa as it is listed under amenities”, so confirm facilities before you book.

It sits on Seventh Avenue in Midtown, close to Broadway theaters, Rockefeller Center and Central Park. It is a large convention-style hotel with many room types for groups. Trip.com shows 7.8 / 10 Good 158 reviews. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “Room is great and clean”. Representative watch-outs: “I expected a sauna/Spa as it is listed under amenities”.
